author: Cyclops
body:
I'm looking for someone to make me an overlay for my twitch channel. Mainly an overlay for Osu!
Example: http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-fCrHidiDY-E/VEvAmTQR3yI/AAAAAAAAAGU/3c4S-1AJUpc/s1600/FutureTwitchOverlay-...
It does not have to be exactly like this, just be creative! (If you played Osu!, you should know the casual overlay for it :P).
I can't really offer anything in return but a thanks in advance. This is volunteer.
